items.title: If Whittemore is right: the management layer is the value
items.body: KPMG's finding that mature organisations run a formal harness layer, with accountable executives, is the kind of governance a practice or PCN could copy: a named owner, an approved-tool list, and a log of what the AI was used for.

items.title: If Zitron is right: price and availability are not guaranteed
items.body: If AI labs depend on venture funding and subsidised usage, today's cheap scribe could cost more later. Build a business case that survives a price rise, and keep a manual fallback.

items.title: OpenAI's safety-team firings
items.body: Whatever the merits, it is a reminder that internal safety processes are not independent assurance. For clinical tools, look for independent evaluation, not the supplier's own.
